serverInfo.name: io.github.kwizzlesurp10-ctrl/x402-mcp
serverInfo.title: x402 Micropayments MCP
serverInfo.description: Pay-per-call HTTP APIs and MCP tools over x402: USDC on Base, gasless settlement, US multi-city rental compliance diligence, and Base gas/finality intelligence.

X402_PAY_TO_ADDRESS.description: Optional 0x USDC address on Base for inbound x402 sales.

EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional burner key for x402.pay_and_fetch and city.check.

tools.name: x402.agent_card
tools.description: Return the A2A Protocol v1.0 Agent ID Card and MCP server card. Optional target_id filters to a skill id, name, or tag.

target_id.description: Optional skill ID, tool name, or tag to inspect. Omit for the full server agent card.
target_id.title: Target Id

agent_id.description: Optional calling agent identifier for quota tracking.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: x402.discover
tools.description: Discover paid HTTP APIs in the x402 Bazaar via the facilitator catalog. Call this first to find a resource URL, then x402.probe and x402.pay_and_fetch.

query.description: Optional Bazaar search substring. Example: 'weather' or 'image'. Omit to list recent paid HTTP services.
query.title: Query

limit.description: Maximum number of catalog entries to return. Default 20. Range 1–100.
limit.title: Limit

max_price_usdc.description: Optional USDC price ceiling. Example: 0.05. Omit to include any listed price.
max_price_usdc.title: Max Price Usdc

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting. Example: 'agent-42'. Omit to use the anonymous free-tier id.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: x402.probe
tools.description: Probe a URL for HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms using the x402 client SDK. Use before x402.pay_and_fetch to inspect price, network, and payTo without spending.

url.description: Absolute HTTP URL to probe. Example: 'https://x402-mcp.onrender.com/us/mn/property-check?address=1700%20Penn%20Ave%20N'.
url.title: Url

method.description: HTTP method for the probe. Default GET. Example: 'GET' or 'POST'.
method.title: Method

headers.description: Optional extra request headers as a string map. Example: {"Accept": "application/json"}. Omit if none.
headers.title: Headers

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting. Omit for the anonymous free-tier id.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: x402.pay_and_fetch
tools.description: Pay USDC via x402 and fetch a protected HTTP resource in one call. Requires EVM_PRIVATE_KEY on this host; otherwise use x402.probe for a no-spend 402.

url.description: Absolute paid HTTP URL to fetch after settling USDC.
url.title: Url

method.description: HTTP method for the paid request. Default GET.
method.title: Method

headers.description: Optional extra request headers as a string map. Omit if none.
headers.title: Headers

body.description: Optional raw request body for POST/PUT. Omit for GET.
body.title: Body

preferred_network.description: Preferred CAIP-2 network. Example: 'eip155:8453' (Base mainnet). Omit to use the server default. Call x402.networks to list options.
preferred_network.title: Preferred Network

max_price_usdc.description: Optional spend ceiling in USDC. Example: 0.10. Calls above this are blocked.
max_price_usdc.title: Max Price Usdc

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: x402.build_seller
tools.description: Build seller-side x402 payment requirements for your own HTTP resource. Pass resource_url plus discovery_* fields to catalog the endpoint in Bazaar.

network.description: CAIP-2 settlement network. Default eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia). Mainnet: eip155:8453.
network.title: Network

pay_to.description: 0x recipient for USDC. Example: '0x67ff…'. Omit to use X402_PAY_TO_ADDRESS.
pay_to.title: Pay To

resource_url.description: Public URL of the paid resource. When set with discovery_* fields, Bazaar catalogs the endpoint after a settled payment.
resource_url.title: Resource Url

discoverable.description: If true, embed the Bazaar discovery extension. Omit to use server default.
discoverable.title: Discoverable

discovery_method.description: HTTP method advertised to Bazaar. Default GET.
discovery_method.title: Discovery Method

discovery_input_example.description: Optional example input object for Bazaar. Omit if none.
discovery_input_example.title: Discovery Input Example

discovery_output_example.description: Optional example output object for Bazaar. Omit if none.
discovery_output_example.title: Discovery Output Example

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: x402.verify
tools.description: Verify an x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE against PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms via the facilitator. Call after a buyer presents a signature and before releasing paid content.

payment_signature.description: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value from the buyer.
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

payment_required.description: PAYMENT-REQUIRED JSON/header the signature is meant to satisfy.
payment_required.title: Payment Required

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: x402.policy_check
tools.description: Decode a caller-supplied merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and evaluate each accepts[] option against an explicit buyer policy (networks, pay_to, assets, max atomic amount). Does not fetch merchant URLs or settle the inspected purchase. Unpaid → PaymentRequired for this server's analysis fee; pay via _meta['x402/payment']. Pass policy as a JSON object string.

payment_required_header.description: Inspected merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (base64 wire from HTTP 402).
payment_required_header.title: Payment Required Header

policy.description: Buyer policy JSON object as a string. Example: {"allowed_networks":["eip155:84532"],"max_amount_atomic":"10000000"}
policy.title: Policy

request_digest.description: Optional JSON string with canonical_url, http_method, body_sha256.
request_digest.title: Request Digest

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: x402.networks
tools.description: List supported settlement networks, facilitators, and x402 v2 header names. Call when choosing a preferred_network for x402.pay_and_fetch or x402.build_seller.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: commerce.pro_requirements
tools.description: Build x402 payment requirements to purchase the Pro quota tier. Next: pay those terms, then commerce.activate_pro with the signature.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity the Pro grant will attach to.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: commerce.activate_pro
tools.description: Verify a Pro-tier x402 payment and unlock Pro quota limits for the agent. MCP-native: call without payment to receive x402 requirements in the tool result, then retry with _meta['x402/payment'] (@x402/mcp client). Legacy: pass PAYMENT-SIGNATURE + PAYMENT-REQUIRED after commerce.pro_requirements.

payment_signature.description: Legacy HTTP-style PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Omit for MCP x402/payment transport.
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

payment_required.description: Legacy PAYMENT-REQUIRED from commerce.pro_requirements. Ignored when using MCP _meta payment.
payment_required.title: Payment Required

agent_id.description: Agent identity to grant Pro quota. Must match the requirements call.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: commerce.credits_requirements
tools.description: Build x402 payment requirements to buy a pack of per-use MCP tool credits. Next: pay those terms, then commerce.purchase_credits with the signature.

credits.description: Credit pack size to buy. Example: 100. Omit to use the server default pack.
credits.title: Credits

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity the credits will attach to.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: commerce.purchase_credits
tools.description: Verify an x402 payment and add per-use tool credits to the agent. MCP-native: call without payment for x402 requirements, then retry with _meta['x402/payment']. Legacy: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE + PAYMENT-REQUIRED after commerce.credits_requirements.

payment_signature.description: Legacy PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Omit for MCP x402/payment transport.
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

credits.description: Credit pack size that was purchased. Must match the requirements call.
credits.title: Credits

agent_id.description: Agent identity to credit.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: swarm.research
tools.description: Run the swarm agency: compose a research product from free inputs and list it for resale. Pass allow_paid_inputs=true only when buying upstream x402 services is intended.

topic.description: Research topic to compose. Example: 'Base mainnet gas window'.
topic.title: Topic

max_price_usdc.description: Optional USDC ceiling for any paid upstream inputs.
max_price_usdc.title: Max Price Usdc

agent_id.description: Seller agent identity that will own the listing.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

allow_paid_inputs.description: If true, buy upstream x402 services before composing. Default false (free inputs only, unsold inventory costs nothing).
allow_paid_inputs.title: Allow Paid Inputs

tools.name: swarm.settle
tools.description: Verify and settle a buyer's x402 payment for a listed composite product and record revenue. Call with product_id plus PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after the buyer pays.

product_id.description: Listed composite product id. Example: the hex id from swarm.research.
product_id.title: Product Id

agent_id.description: Seller agent identity recording the sale.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: swarm.revenue
tools.description: Get swarm composite economics: spend, composite sales, LTV:CAC, margins, per-source scores. total_revenue_usdc is swarm listings only; storefront.revenue_usdc is the full settled ledger. Call after swarm.research or swarm.settle to inspect realized economics.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: pulse.base
tools.description: Get live Base Network Pulse: base fee, EIP-1559 projection, utilization, USD settlement cost, verdict. Call before settling on Base when you need a settle-now vs hold recommendation.

depth.description: Blocks to sample. Example: 12. Omit to use the server default.
depth.title: Depth

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: ops.metrics
tools.description: Get host OS telemetry: CPU, memory, swap, disk, network, and an ok/warn/critical health verdict. Call to diagnose this MCP host; set include_processes=true for top memory processes.

include_processes.description: If true, include top processes by memory. Default false.
include_processes.title: Include Processes

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: city.list
tools.description: List US cities with paid_url and free sample_url for property compliance. Start here — each paid lookup is $0.01 USDC and returns a normalized verdict plus source link, not raw portal JSON. Then city.sample, then city.check. Covers Minneapolis, Minnesota rental licensing (city_code mn) and other US cities.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: city.sample
tools.description: Free fixed-address preview of paid property-check JSON (verdict, summary, schema). Use before city.check to validate parsing without spending $0.01 USDC.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: city.check
tools.description: Is this US address licensed / flagged / showing open violations? One city.check ($0.01 USDC, x402 on Base) returns verdict, summary, dates, and source_url. Unpaid → PaymentRequired; pay via _meta['x402/payment']. Prefer city.sample first.

address.description: Street address to check. Example: '1700 Penn Ave N' or '1 Centre St'.
address.title: Address

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

tools.name: a2a.resolve_card
tools.description: Discover and inspect an external Agent-to-Agent (A2A) node by domain or URL. Fetches .well-known/agent-card.json, validates protocol compatibility, checks for a2a-x402 and AP2 payment extensions, and extracts callable skills with pricing.

target.description: Host domain or full URL of the agent (e.g. 'agent.example.com' or 'https://agent.example.com/.well-known/agent-card.json')
target.title: Target

agent_id.description: Optional calling agent identifier for quota tracking.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

prompts.name: x402.buy_paid_api
prompts.description: Walk an agent through discovering, probing, then paying for an x402 HTTP resource.

prompts.name: x402.sell_api
prompts.description: Walk an agent through building seller PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms and listing an endpoint in Bazaar.

prompts.name: city.compliance_path
prompts.description: Golden path for US City Open-Data Compliance: list → sample → paid check.

resources.name: x402.instructions
resources.description: Server routing guide: which dotted tool to call, in what order, for buyer/seller/city flows.

resources.name: x402.catalog
resources.description: JSON catalog of dotted tool names, descriptions, and required env vars.

resources.name: x402.agent-card
resources.description: Full A2A Protocol v1.0 Agent ID Card and capability descriptor.

resources.name: x402.server-card
resources.description: Remote MCP Server Card for Smithery, Glama, and client indexing.

resources.name: x402.tools-manifest
resources.description: Canonical MCP well-known manifest with tool specs, quotas, and endpoints.

resources.name: x402.pricing-table
resources.description: Machine-readable pricing for micropayments, subscriptions, and credits.

legal: Payment for delivered products, documentation/audit artifacts, or a voluntary tip. Not a token, not equity, not a raise.
